conceptZh: 手指或腳趾末端的硬殼。
object: a tiny felt ninja, a stubborn ladybug-shaped nail clipper, and a pot of orange polish
morph: the clipper fights back until the ninja outwits it and 甲 forms
creativeAngle: 布忍者與不聽話的瓢蟲剪刀鬥智，最後排成「甲」；甲蟲現身。
promptEn: An 8-second silly animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. Behind a paper screen in a peach-and-mint dojo, a tiny felt ninja tiptoes up to a ladybug-shaped nail clipper that has its own opinions. 0–1.6s: The ninja freezes mid-sneak; the first 甲 is spoken as the clipper clacks and snips a stroke out of its square, snapping at his mask. 1.6–3.2s: The second 甲 is spoken: the clipper chomps his sleeve and drags him around the floor, while he hides behind a tiny bamboo leaf that is obviously too small. 3.2–4.7s: The ninja drops a throw-net, the clipper tangles and wriggles in tiny circles, and the pieces fall in place: 甲 in forest green. 4.7–5.7s: As 甲蟲 is spoken, the clipper's shell flips open and a shiny beetle in the shape of a ladybug crawls out, waving a leg; the ninja bows. Final hold (about 5.0–8.0s): the ninja makes a victory roll behind the paper screen, still thinking he is invisible; the glyph is still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly this line, slowly and distinctly with the marked tones, then stops: 甲、甲、甲蟲（ㄐㄧㄚˇ、ㄐㄧㄚˇ、ㄐㄧㄚˇ ㄔㄨㄥˊ）. The first 甲 lands at about 0.9s, the second 甲 at about 2.6s, and the word 甲蟲 at about 4.9s, each timed to the picture described above. On-screen text is limited to the one glyph 甲 in strong solid color over a light bright background; the spoken word is never shown as text. The glyph 甲 fills roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped, and stays perfectly still for the final 3 seconds while the lead keeps playing away from the strokes. No real people, no flashing.

conceptZh: 浣熊助手花生抱著一疊搖搖晃晃的積木小隊，衝向一根巨大的玩具大拇指，「碰」一聲撞扁；飛散的積木掉下來排成「甲」，中間最長的那根往下一滑，像指甲底下的手指。
object: a cartoon raccoon sidekick carrying a teetering tower of long smooth building bricks toward a giant squishy pastel-pink toy thumb with one huge glossy fingernail
morph: the crash flings the bricks into the air; four bricks drop as the outer box, one lands as the middle crossbar, and the longest brick slides straight down the center and pokes out below the box, completing 甲
creativeAngle: 全新「助跑衝撞」結構：前一版是忍者和瓢蟲指甲剪的安靜小劇場，這次改成花生抱著積木小隊從左到右全速衝向巨大拇指，撞擊本身把積木震成「甲」的筆畫，最後一根長積木往下滑出框外正好交代「甲」的直筆穿出。積木小隊的敬禮害堆疊搖晃，構成「先失敗再加大助跑」的節奏；「指甲」一詞由花生舉爪、爪尖彈出亮粉色指甲蓋來對應畫面。
promptEn:
An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel toy-world look, soft even daylight, no dark grading. A pale butter-yellow floor and wall, nothing busy behind. The lead is Peanut, a round cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail and a tiny bellhop cap, hugging a teetering tower of six long smooth building bricks, each with a tiny sleepy face and little arms. Far on the right side of the frame sits a giant squishy pastel-pink toy thumb, taller than Peanut, with one enormous glossy fingernail on top.

0–1.5s: Peanut shuffles in from the left, the brick tower swaying far over his head. He spots the giant thumb, points at it with his whole arm, narrows his eyes with determination, digs both feet into the floor and leans way back in a huge wind-up. The first 甲 is spoken at about 0.9s exactly as he digs in and leans back.

1.5–3.2s: First try. He bolts forward, but the top brick snaps a crisp salute, the whole tower leans backward and Peanut runs in place, legs blurring, going nowhere. He skids back to the left edge, squashes down even lower, tail quivering, and the bricks all salute at once. The second 甲 is spoken at about 2.6s as he rockets off the mark, a cartoon dust puff behind him.

3.2–4.7s: The big BONK. Peanut slams face-first into the squishy pad of the giant thumb; the thumb squashes flat then springs back, and Peanut flattens like a pancake against it. The impact flings all six bricks straight up in a clean arc. They drop one at a time with soft clunks into the center of the frame: four bricks land as the outer box, one brick lands across the middle as the crossbar, and the longest brick slides straight down the center and pokes out below the box. The moment they touch, the faces fade and the bricks lock into smooth solid deep-cobalt-blue strokes, finishing the correct glyph 甲 by about 4.6s.

4.7–5.8s: Peanut peels off the thumb and wobbles upright at bottom-left, well clear of the strokes. The word 指甲 is spoken at about 4.9s exactly as he thrusts one paw high toward the camera and a glossy pink nail cap pops onto his claw tip with a tiny sparkle, while the giant thumb's huge nail gleams in reply. He salutes with the wrong paw and nearly tips over.

5.0–8.0s final hold: the glyph 甲 stays perfectly still, centered and uncropped, filling roughly 70% of frame height with clear margins. Peanut, dizzy and grinning, does a slow wobbly stagger and a tiny proud two-step at bottom-left, admiring his shiny claw, never touching or covering the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly these syllables, slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops: 甲、甲、指甲（ㄐㄧㄚˇ、ㄐㄧㄚˇ、ㄓˇ ㄐㄧㄚˇ）. No other speech, no translation, no subtitles, no vocabulary text; only the single glyph 甲 appears as on-screen text. Soft cartoon thuds and a gentle sparkle, any music quieter than the voice. Stylized toy and cartoon characters only, no real people, no brands, no flashing effects, no watermark.
